summary: Round-9 delta scan, 12:46-12:50 UTC 26 Sep, compared with round 8 (LB 10:23 UTC). Public LB: 3,928 teams. We are rank 204 (189), still 0.954 with 40 subs, 13th of 93 in the 0.954 block (ranks 192-284). Public silver (5% = rank 196) is now 8 ranks ABOVE us; in round 8 we were 7 ranks inside it. This is info only per R7 and the 11:06 UTC record, because private decides. The overnight batch (subs 02:30-06:30 UTC) landed. >=0.953 grew 597->619 (+22 in 2.4 h). Block counts (round 8 in brackets): 0.953 = 335 (333), 0.954 = 93 (85), 0.955 = 55 (50), 0.956 = 30 (27), 0.957 = 20 (17), >=0.960 = 67 (64), >=0.970 = 7 (7). We lost 15 ranks: about 9 teams from below jumped to >=0.955, and 4 teams that also show 0.954 were placed ahead of us (cesare from 0.947, PavelLiashkov, Ernesto Santiesteban, and MAIDANG, whose sub moved it from #228 to #203). This fits in-block order by the unrounded score. Top mover: 'Bioinformatics is not solution' 0.959->0.966 (#66->#17). Ranks 1-16 are unchanged. 17 more x138 copies landed at exactly 0.953 (#586-602), the 9th window in a row. Public: nothing to port. The only new or updated public notebook is sarveshchhetri/robust-3d-cell-tracking (0.432; another round-9 agent already pulled it). The only new dataset is kssrikar4/biohub-model (UNETR++ .pth, owner at 0.758). x138 is still v1 (199 votes, 277 copies). E10 is NOT triggered. Discussion has no new topic and one new comment: the 743006 author asks whether the 44b6/6bba prefixes identify embryos, with no host reply. The Overview has no changes apart from the countdown ('3 DAYS TO GO', 29 Sep deadline, 12 h limits). Data files are unchanged (2026-06-26). There is no host announcement. Submissions are 87,065 (~105/h, slowing). The finals (#37 + #38) are unaffected.
